Contract Generator.contract:
Contract SubmitLoanRequestModule::enterLoanInformation(requestid: Integer,name: String,loanamount: Real,loanpurpose: String,income: Real,phonenumber: Integer,postaladdress: String,zipcode: Integer,email: String,workreferences: String,creditreferences: String,checkingaccountnumber: Integer,securitynumber: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		loanRequest: LoanRequest = LoanRequest.allInstance()->any(o|o.RequestID = requestid),
		isNew: Boolean = loanRequest.oclIsNew()
	precondition:
		LoanRequest.allInstance()->includes(loanRequest) = bool
	postcondition:
		if isNew 
		then let loanRequest: LoanRequest in
		loanRequest.oclIsNew() and
		loanRequest.RequestID = requestid and
		loanRequest.Name = name and
		loanRequest.LoanAmount = loanamount and
		loanRequest.LoanPurpose = loanpurpose and
		loanRequest.Income = income and
		loanRequest.PhoneNumber = phonenumber and
		loanRequest.PostalAddress = postaladdress and
		loanRequest.ZipCode = zipcode and
		loanRequest.Email = email and
		loanRequest.WorkReferences = workreferences and
		loanRequest.CreditReferences = creditreferences and
		loanRequest.CheckingAccountNumber = checkingaccountnumber and
		loanRequest.SecurityNumber = securitynumber and
		LoanRequest.allInstance()->includes(loanRequest) 
		else result = true 
		endif 
}
